ws2 = wb["Sheet2"]

# Determine source/target columns by header names, based on the layout/instruction.
def header_map(ws, header_row=1):
    result = {}
    for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        v = ws.cell(header_row, c).value
        if isinstance(v, str):
